{"sql":"SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS MediaType, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds)/60000.0, 2) AS AvgMinutes, COUNT(*) AS TrackCount

GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
ORDER BY m.MediaTypeId;"}
